summary: Iter64: Tested auto-filling founding capital for legacy accounts and adding non-vehicle income to profit and equity. Backend: 5/5 pytest pass (test_iter64_auto_founding_other_income.py). (1) The baseline matches: founding 1.005.000 (auto), cash 145.000, stock 1.100.000, assets 1.245.000, equity 1.245.000, net profit 240.000. (2) Legacy simulation (founding 0, founding_defined/founding_auto unset): founding = assets − retained earnings, equity == assets, founding_auto=true, and the value persists to Mongo and is stable on the 2nd call. (3) Komisyon 20k gives cash/assets/equity/net_profit +20k each, other_income_period +20k and founding unchanged. Permanent delete reverts everything. (4) Kapora 5k does not change net_profit or other_income. Cash rises 5k but equity does not. (5) founding/adjust increase 100k sets founding_auto=false and raises founding/cash/equity/assets by 100k with net profit unchanged. Deleting the Sermaye Artırımı tx reverts. UI 1920x1080, all PASS: the founding card subtitle is 'Eski kayıtlardan otomatik hesaplandı' and the set-founding banner is absent. Adding Komisyon via Genel İşlem modal (income cats: Komisyon, Diğer Gelir) gives dashboard 1.005.000 / 1.265.000 / 165.000 / Net Kâr 260.000 '2 satış · ₺20.000 diğer gelir' / 1.265.000. The row shows in Gelir & Gider (Gelir ₺20.000). Sermaye Düzenle → Artır 100k gives 1.105.000 'Sabit öz sermaye referansı' / 1.345.000 / 245.000 / 240.000 / 1.345.000 with toast 'Sermaye artırıldı'. Mobile 390x844: 2-col grid, cards 173px, scrollWidth 390, no overflow. Baseline restored and verified.

minor.issue: The auto-fill only saves when derived > 0. If total_assets <= retained earnings (e.g. heavy past profit with low current assets), founding stays 0 and the card shows '—' again with equity ≠ assets. Consider saving 0 with founding_defined=true or showing an explanation.
A GET endpoint has a write side effect (one-time auto-fill of org_settings). It is acceptable but undocumented. Concurrent first calls are idempotent enough (same value).

Kapora raises cash/total assets but not equity (correct: it is a liability). With no liability/Kapora card, equity ≠ total assets will reappear while deposits are open, which is the same perceived inconsistency the user complained about. Consider a subtitle such as 'X₺ kapora (emanet)' on Toplam Varlık or Kasa.

ui_bugs.issue: The header text 'Net Kâr (₺240.000) ≠ Kasa' uses Dashboard.jsx's local netProfit useMemo (car sales only). With a Komisyon tx it still showed ₺240.000 while the Net Kâr card showed ₺260.000. It should use summary.net_profit or add other income.

action_items: Dashboard.jsx: make the CashFlowVisual netProfit consistent with summary.net_profit (include non-vehicle income).
Optional: handle the derived <= 0 case in the finance_summary auto-fill.
Optional: show open Kapora (liability) on the dashboard so that equity ≠ assets is explained.
critical_code_review_comments: finance.py: NON_PROFIT_INCOME_CATEGORIES is defined between imports (line 21, before the expense_classifier import). It works, but move it below the imports for readability.
finance.py: other_income_period date filter uses string compare on t['date'] (YYYY-MM-DD). This is fine if all tx dates are ISO, but it breaks if any have a time component and end_date has no time.
capital.py: all founding writes set founding_auto=False, which is correct. Deleting the Sermaye Artırımı tx reverts founding but leaves founding_auto=false (expected, since the user touched capital).
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Komisyon, Kapora and Sermaye Artırımı test txs were permanently deleted. Baseline restored: org_settings founding_capital=1005000, founding_defined=true, founding_auto=true; cash 145.000, equity 1.245.000.
